events.note: Axel Edvin Lindberg had been at the lookout since May 1 and had manned it the year before (Prince George Citizen item of May 16, 1962, as quoted on the Canada Lookouts page).

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only dated history is a Prince George Citizen item of May 16, 1962, as quoted on the Canada Lookouts page; the newspaper itself was not read, so the wording and date rest on that page. The page says Lindberg 'previously manned it last year'; the story says 'the year before', which is the same thing relative to 1962. No build date, builder, design, height, status or access was found. An Aleza Lake Research Forest Facebook photo post, seen only as a search snippet (the page returned a login wall), refers to 'the old Churchill Fire Lookout near Giscome'. It is not cited and could be checked by a human for the build date and whether anything still stands. The story is shorter than it would be with more evidence and does not state the death's cause beyond the quoted report. Handle the 1962 death with care in any display.
